diagrams.title: Before: copied integration logic
diagrams.description: Four teams copy configuration around existing regional capabilities; the defect is inconsistent contracts and ownership.
nodes: History, audit, usage and model lineage

diagrams.title: After: versioned platform contracts
diagrams.description: A control plane validates desired state while existing regional services enforce runtime safety. The new controller does not process prompts.
nodes: EU or US according to tenant policy
Policy, audit, quotas and stable operations
History, usage, registry and decision records

diagrams.title: Migration sequence
diagrams.description: Propose, compare, review, cut over, observe and roll back if currently eligible; prior route metadata is never authorisation.

lab_title: Does the platform repay its migration cost?
lab_assumptions: Illustrative $100/hour labour, 120 baseline hours/month, $1,000/month incremental control infrastructure and $20,000/month common serving. No discounting, tax or revenue estimate.
